note: Questions written on 2026-09-30 for randomly sampled provisions (scripts/sample-provisions.ts, seed 20260930, --per-area 18 --spares 12). Selection rule fixed before screening: the first 18 eligible provisions per area in sample order, after exclusion rules E1-E4. Provisions already in dev-3 or held-out-3 (same page or same sentence) are excluded under E4. A first draw with --per-area 12 --spares 6 left too few eligible items (about 52) and was discarded before any system run. Written before any system run on them. Facts are short verbatim phrases from the sampled provision; scripts/build-heldout-3.ts checks them and computes accepted documents.

exclusionRules.E1: the sentence is itself an amendment instruction (substituted, inserted, omitted, rescinded) or the commencement of an amendment
exclusionRules.E2: the sentence is cut by footnote text or garbled
exclusionRules.E3: the sentence cannot stand alone as a question (table or form fragment, refers to 'abovementioned', 'these', 'this rule' without context)
exclusionRules.E4: duplicate of an already selected provision (another version of the same rule) or of a provision in dev-3 or held-out-3

excluded.overCap: SEBI items after #63, IBBI items after #128 and RBI/FEMA items after #160 were not used (18 per area reached)
